name: nasa-daac-knowledge
description: Provider knowledge bundles from NASA DAACs, one per archive: PO.DAAC (ECCO, SWOT, GRACE-FO, MUR, NASA-SSH, RAPID), ASDC (CERES radiation budget), NSIDC (land ice and sea ice), GES DISC (MERRA-2, AIRS, OMI, solar-induced fluorescence), LP DAAC (land surface), OB.DAAC (ocean color), ORNL DAAC (surface meteorology and biogeochemistry) and the ESDIS metadata requirements. Facts about data, signed by their stewards; no skills.
